I publish evidence-bound work in AI systems architecture, agent-trace diagnostics, resilience engineering, and interdisciplinary research.

Each release is labeled by status and revision. The purpose is to make claims inspectable, preserve credible disagreement, and expose ideas to correction—not to present unfinished concepts as established science or deployable products.
